description: Turn an OpenAPI/Swagger spec's operations into agent-callable tools, gated by an operationId allow-list.
summary: Expose OpenAPI operations as agent-callable tools: one asset per operation, or a real MCP server built from the spec.

outputs.description: mode='assets': one asset per allow-listed operation, each the operation's parsed HTTP response. mode='mcp_server': a resource exposing the built FastMCP server + a small inspection asset listing its tools.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'assets' (default, simpler, more Dagster-native): one asset per allow-listed operation, each a direct HTTP call. 'mcp_server': build a real fastmcp.FastMCP server from the spec, exposed via a resource (resource_key) other code can host, plus a small inspection asset listing the server's resulting tools.

spec_url.label: Spec URL
spec_url.description: URL to fetch the OpenAPI/Swagger spec from (JSON or YAML). Takes precedence over spec_path if both are set.

spec_path.label: Spec Path
spec_path.description: Local file path to the OpenAPI/Swagger spec (JSON or YAML).

api_base_url_env_var.label: API Base URL Env Var
api_base_url_env_var.description: Env var with the API base URL. Only used as a fallback when the spec has no servers[] entry with a URL.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the API key/token for Authorization.

auth_header.label: Auth Header
auth_header.description: HTTP header name for the credential.

auth_prefix.label: Auth Prefix
auth_prefix.description: Prefix before the credential value in the header, e.g. 'Bearer'. Set to empty string for none (raw key as the header value).

operation_ids.label: Operation IDs
operation_ids.description: Allow-list of operationId values (the OpenAPI spec's own operationId field per operation). Operations NOT in this list are NEVER exposed, in either mode. Leave unset to expose every operation in the spec.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: mode='assets' only. Prefix for emitted asset keys: '{asset_name_prefix}_{operation_id}' (sanitized). Useful to avoid collisions when two instances of this component target different specs.

operation_args.label: Operation Args
operation_args.description: mode='assets' only. Per-operationId call args, keyed by operationId. Each value is a flat dict of {param_name: value} -- matched against the operation's declared path/query/header parameters by name; any key that doesn't match a declared parameter is sent as a JSON request body field. String leaves get template substitution: {partition_key}, {partition_keys.<dim>}, {run_id}.

parse_as.label: Parse As
parse_as.description: mode='assets' only. How to parse each operation's response body: 'json' (raise if not JSON), 'text' (raw string), 'auto' (try JSON, fall back to text).

server_name.label: Server Name
server_name.description: mode='mcp_server' only. Name for the built FastMCP server.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: mode='mcp_server' only. Dagster resource key the built OpenApiMcpServerResource is registered under -- other code (a script, an ASGI mount, a sensor) reads it via context.resources.<resource_key>.build_server() to actually host the server.

inspection_asset_name.label: Inspection Asset Name
inspection_asset_name.description: mode='mcp_server' only. Name of the small inspection asset that lists the built server's resulting tools.

validate_output.label: Validate Output
validate_output.description: mode='mcp_server' only. Passed through to FastMCP.from_openapi -- validate tool responses against the spec's output schema.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description. mode='assets': applied to every emitted operation asset unless the operation has its own OpenAPI summary.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Extra asset tags, applied to every emitted asset.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog. mode='assets' always adds 'api' and 'openapi' (even if you set your own kinds), the same way mcp_tool_call always adds 'mcp' -- so a UI can find every operation asset this component emits by kind alone.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: mode='assets' only. 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'hourly' | 'cron' | 'static' | 'multi' | 'dynamic'. Applied to every emitted operation asset.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying time-based partitions definition. 0 means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying time-based partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset).

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values} dicts.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: mode='assets' only. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run (one HTTP call per partition in the range, each with its own {partition_key} substitution). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave unset for Dagster's default.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For backfill_policy='multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run.

name: OpenAPI Tool Server
